definitions: An international observance declared by the United Nations to raise awareness of violence against women and girls worldwide.
examples: The International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women is observed annually on November 25th.
Activists organized a march on the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women.
lemma: International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
synonyms: UN Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
source: International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women
